tests: R34 R9 ALREADY_ATTACHED stands for every attachment whatever the viewer may see, and is answered within the viewer's sight: it names the escalation and stage already attached only where the viewer may see that escalation; for one in a project the viewer may not see it names nothing of it (no id, stage or count), one answer, the same as for an action attached nowhere it could name; nothing is written

R34 attachConditions({id, action, viewer}) answers, at stage 7, R12's counterparty conditions per accountability purpose for the action's addressee, as R9 would judge them on the day read: an office the profile marks elected: false answers official_request refused COUNTERPARTY_NOT_ELECTED, testimony and enforcing_legislation asking no condition; it writes nothing and chooses nothing, and each answer agrees with what R9 then does

tests: R1 R4 R14 over the real conformance: a live noncompliant determination opens at stage 1 pursuing its noncompliant standard, the actor's office proposes 1→2, and compliance is restored only by a later live compliant determination of the same act id; consequences, read through the real module, stays undetermined with none recorded
R9 over the real actions: a breach action resting on the determination attaches at stage 2; one not recorded for the breach does not; an absent one is NO_SUCH_ACTION

R5 R6 R7 over the real actions (K256): a sent entry on the attached breach action, recorded through actions.actionCorrespond, meets 2→3 at its date; a reply after it meets 3→4; the reply is evaluated at stage 4
R1 over the real conformance: NO_SUCH_DETERMINATION (absent and unseen) and DETERMINATION_SUPERSEDED are conformance's own answers, R19's and R20's, exactly

R23 over the real actions (K600 (a)): a member's breach action stating a premise_override (with its ground, R74), written through actions with no determination to rest on, is refused ACTION_PREMISE_OVERRIDDEN at an attaching stage, ahead of NOT_A_BREACH_ACTION; one resting on the determination without the override attaches; once a revision adds the leg, the overridden action attaches with its override shown

R29 over the real conformance, actions and consequences (their published shapes): the draft states the noncompliant standard with the basis the determination holds, the act, the breach action resting on it with its clock and its date passed at nowMs, and no consequence recorded; writes nothing

R4 R29 R30 over the real conformance: the actor's office entity, filled by the bridge, is resolved through entities; one the bridge does not hold is unresolved and still proposes 1→2; the draft words the act from its event; the timeline source finds the escalation by the act's event and by the actor's entity

R12 over the real actions and conformance: an oversight request to an office the profile marks not an oversight body is refused with no line held, and lands once that office holds an oversees line to the actor's office entity on the day, the read naming the line; the stage-7 read offers that office as a target

R14 over the real conformance (T45-23, K2852): a later act of the same office, determined compliant after the escalation opened and linked through conformance.cureLink, restores compliance (escalationEnd then asks the consequences); before the link, and for another office's compliant act never linked, COMPLIANCE_NOT_RESTORED names the standard

R7 stage 4: its act is a member's evaluation; to 5 and to 7 when the latest evaluation since entering stage 4 reads denied, partial or none, first met at the evaluation and named <id>/evaluation#<n>, n its place among the escalation's evaluations, counting no other entry; complied proposes no stage and points at R14; partial is recorded and neither stops the clock nor ends the escalation

R8 stage 5: breach actions attached here with their filings or counsel packets (filings.filingsFor); what is available listed through filings.availableActions for the determination; to 6 when an attached action's ledger holds a sent entry; to 7 from the evaluation in force, named by R7's id

R11 stage 6 is entered from 5 and has no act of its own; its trigger to 4 is a received entry on an attached action recorded after the latest evaluation

R12 stage 7, entered from 4 or 5: each attachment states one accountability purpose and at least one pursued standard; NOT_ACCOUNTABILITY, NOT_THE_BREACH, COUNTERPARTY_NOT_ELECTED (official_request to an office marked not elected), COUNTERPARTY_NOT_OVERSIGHT (oversight or audit request to one marked not oversight); where the profile says nothing it lands and the read states it undetermined; trigger to 4 as R11's
